evidence: We use artificial intelligence ("AI") to support health care transformation by helping to enable the next generation of accessible, effective, affordable and enhanced health care solutions.
AI models can facilitate personalized solutions for individuals, inform earlier interventions and simplify health care experiences.

The combination of our predictive analytics, and our machine learning ("ML") and deep learning capabilities help to uncover trends, anticipate needs and create actionable intelligence that assists and accelerates decision-making of our health care professionals.
We have a dedicated team and governance structure in place, known as Enterprise Model Governance ("EMG") that oversees the development, deployment and monitoring of AI models.

Our AI Center of Enablement ("AI COE") brings together individuals from across our technology, privacy, data governance, security, legal, compliance, marketing and other teams to evaluate and approve Gen AI use cases.
ai_positioning.summary: CI intègre l'IA et le machine learning en interne pour transformer ses opérations de santé (prédiction, personnalisation, optimisation des décisions cliniques) avec une gouvernance structurée via EMG et AI COE, tout en reconnaissant les risques réglementaires et de réputation associés.
